summary: Batch A, family A11 (minimum-degree lower bounds). GTBase.base.min_degree_at_least G d := forall v : G, d <= #|N(v)| is the universal lower bound beside Delta/regular, not an attained minimum: K0 and an empty induced subgraph satisfy every bound and no nonemptiness is added. Ten local copies (X203, Cycle XE2, X13, X30, XE1, X38, X74, X211 min_degree_geq, X135, X47) convert to it; X13's induced adapter is min_degree_at_least (induced S) d on the supplied S (subtype kept); XE1's no-isolated-vertices forall v, 0 < #|N(v)| is the bound 1 (min_degree_at_least1P).

Seventeen rows are frozen verbatim at 9abf440 with two chains (X13 bipartite induced bound, XE1 C4-forcing minimum degree); whole quantifiers, natural subtraction, Ramsey witnesses, growth hypotheses and exact arithmetic bounds are unchanged, and X203's empty-graph defect and blocked status are kept. Eight complete Originals: #85 (frozen bound with A5's frozen containment, through a new original chain), #545/#566/#567/#568/#570 (frozen no-isolated bound with A7's frozen count and #566 sparse-set chain, A6's frozen Ramsey number and B4's frozen h5) Cycle #752 (frozen bound with B10's frozen cycle lengths over its frozen genuine cycles; follow-up on the B10 union) and X38 (A10's frozen raw incidence count and degree classes with the frozen bound; the M1 alias stays live as in A10, no pre-M1 claim). Each complete row converts to the earlier family's complete or per-row certificate, whose bridge it reuses. Earlier A5, A6, A7, B4 and A10 snapshots that keep a live A11 bound are documented here, and A11's per-row copies are documented reciprocally in their specs. Exact minima, subcubic/cubic, scaled, directed and hypergraph contracts stay distinct.
